species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 63°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 65 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 100 ft, so fish stay above it.
South wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the north shore: try the wind-blown banks.
